# Baidu's HK shares hit near 4-week high on assessing unit spin-off plan

RefinitivLess than 1 min read

[BIDU](/symbols/NASDAQ-BIDU/)[HSI](/symbols/HSI-HSI/)[HHSTECH](/symbols/HSI-HSTECH/)[HHSAMI](/symbols/HSI-HSAMI/)

\*\* Hong Kong shares of Chinese internet search giant Baidu Inc [BIDU](/symbols/NASDAQ-BIDU/) climb 5.2% to HK$127.9, their highest level since November 13, and on course for a third consecutive session of gains

\*\* Stock set for the biggest one-day pct gain since October 27; top pct gainer in the Hang Seng Index [HSI](/symbols/HSI-HSI/) and Hang Seng Tech Index [HHSTECH](/symbols/HSI-HSTECH/), which are down 0.4% and up 0.2%, respectively

\*\* U.S.-listed stock [BIDU](/symbols/NASDAQ-BIDU/) rose 5.9% on Friday

\*\* Baidu says it is assessing proposed spin-off and separate listing of Kunlunxin (Beijing) Technology and, if proceeded, the spin-off and listing will subject to relevant regulatory approval process

\*\* Baidu's AI chip unit Kunlunxin is planning an initial public offering in Hong Kong, having recently completed a fundraising that valued it at 21 billion yuan ($2.97 billion), three people familiar with the matter told Reuters

\*\* YTD, Baidu's Hong Kong stock up 52.4%, U.S.-listed shares up 49.2%

# Baidu's Hong Kong shares jump on report AI chip unit plans listing

RefinitivLess than 1 min read

[BIDU](/symbols/NASDAQ-BIDU/)[HHSTECH](/symbols/HSI-HSTECH/)[HHSAMI](/symbols/HSI-HSAMI/)[HSI](/symbols/HSI-HSI/)

\*\* Hong Kong shares of Chinese internet search giant Baidu Inc [BIDU](/symbols/NASDAQ-BIDU/) jump 7.8% to HK$124.8, their highest level since November 13, and on course for a second straight session of gains

\*\* Stock set for the biggest one-day pct gain since September 17; top pct gainer in the Hang Seng Tech Index [HHSTECH](/symbols/HSI-HSTECH/) and Hang Seng Automobile Index [HHSAMI](/symbols/HSI-HSAMI/), which are up 0.2% and 0.5%, respectively

\*\* Kunlunxin, the AI chip unit of Baidu, is planning an initial public offering in Hong Kong, having recently completed a fundraising that valued it at 21 billion yuan ($2.97 billion), three people familiar with the matter told Reuters

\*\* Kunlunxin joins a wave of Chinese chip companies planning public listings and follows listing of graphics processing units maker Moore Threads (688795.SS), which debuted on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Friday at more than five times its IPO price

\*\* YTD, Baidu's Hong Kong stock up 47.2%, U.S.-listed shares [BIDU](/symbols/NASDAQ-BIDU/) up 40.8%

# Google Drive update makes navigating PDFs and files effortless

[News](https://www.androidcentral.com/news)

By [Jay Bonggolto](https://www.androidcentral.com/author/jay-bonggolto)   published

Google Drive just fixed its clunkiest feature.

 [Comments (0) ()](#viafoura-comments)

(Image credit: Harish Jonnalagadda / Android Central)

## What you need to know

* Google Drive finally dumps its outdated file viewer, replacing it with a cleaner, faster, and far more useful interface.
* PDF viewing gets a massive upgrade with a sidebar table of contents and page thumbnails.
* The new video transcript search lets you jump straight to any spoken keyword.

Disclaimer

Enjoy our content? Make sure to [**set Android Central as a preferred source**](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=androidcentral.com) in Google Search, and [**find out why you should**](https://www.androidcentral.com/apps-software/ask-jerry-how-to-curate-your-google-news-search-and-why-you-should) so that you can stay up-to-date on the latest news, reviews, features, and more.

For a long time, opening a file in Google Drive felt outdated, especially when you were just trying to read a PDF in your browser. Now, that old experience is finally gone.

Google Drive on the web is getting rid of its old, clunky viewer. What used to be a basic, sometimes frustrating way to open PDFs, images, and videos [is being replaced](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2025/12/google-drive-web-modern-file-viewer-interface.html) with a cleaner, more useful workspace.

This update fixes common complaints about how you move around, organize, and use the Drive viewer. If you spend a lot of time jumping between documents or reviewing media straight from your browser, you’ll feel the difference immediately.

## PDFs in Drive finally make sense

The biggest improvement is for PDFs, which have always been a weak spot in Drive. The new viewer now shows a table of contents on the left if the file has one, along with thumbnail previews for every page. You no longer have to scroll endlessly through a hundred-page document hoping to land on the right paragraph.

This new interface pairs nicely with [Drive’s Gemini-powered audio summaries](https://www.androidcentral.com/apps-software/google-drives-new-ai-audio-summaries-make-pdfs-effortless). You can generate and listen to a quick overview right from the side panel, or jump into the “Audio overviews” folder to replay anything you’ve saved.

Google didn’t stop at PDFs, though. Video files get a surprisingly powerful upgrade with a transcript search tool built right into the viewer. Instead of scrubbing back and forth trying to find the exact moment someone mentions a keyword, you can type the word directly into the transcript and jump straight to that point in the video.

This feature saves you time right away, especially if you work with long recordings or meeting videos.

All of this sits atop a refreshed interface that looks cleaner and behaves more predictably. The toolbar has been redesigned, the file menu is more intuitive, and the overall layout feels less cramped.

The rollout is already underway for users on Google’s Rapid Release track, while Scheduled Release domains will begin seeing the new viewer starting December 11, 2025. The update is available for both personal and Workspace users.

# Microsoft Issues ‘Critical Update’ For All Windows 11 Users

By[Zak Doffman](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zakdoffman/ "https://www.forbes.com/sites/zakdoffman/"),

Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights.

 Zak Doffman writes about security, surveillance and privacy.

While the Windows world focuses on [failed updates](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zakdoffman/2025/11/29/microsoft-confirms-windows-password-failure-no-fix-available/) and a new [automated upgrade](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zakdoffman/2025/12/07/microsoft-confirms-new-upgrade-decision-for-all-windows-users/) that has just gone live for all users, Microsoft has also just issued a new Windows 11 update it describes as “critical.” It’s available for download now.

As spotted by [*Neowin*](https://www.neowin.net/news/microsoft-released-windows-11-kb5071844-recovery-update/), this new dynamic update “brings improvements to the Windows Recovery process in the form of WinRE updates, which are also called Safe OS updates. The dynamic updates also affect the Setup file binaries in the form of Setup updates.”

[ForbesIs Your Boss Using New Microsoft And Google Updates To Spy On You?By Zak Doffman](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zakdoffman/2025/12/07/is-your-boss-using-new-microsoft-and-google-updates-to-spy-on-you/)

These updates “include fixes to Setup.exebinaries, SafeOS updates for Windows Recovery Environment, and more. Dynamic Updates also help preserve Language Pack (LP) and Features on Demand (FODs) content during the upgrade process.”

Because Windows 11 version 23H2 is now end-of-support, the new updates are only available for Windows 11 25H2, Windows 11 24H2 and Windows Server 2025."

MORE FOR YOU

[Microsoft](https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/topic/kb5071844-safe-os-dynamic-update-for-windows-11-version-24h2-and-25h2-and-windows-server-2025-december-1-2025-281bf3ec-bec2-45a0-9f4d-ac0776a09ba4) says “this update is available through Windows Update. It will be downloaded and installed automatically.” The company also notes that “there are no prerequisites to apply this update, you do not have to restart your device after you apply this update (and) this update cannot be removed once it is applied to a Windows image.”

[WinRE](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/manufacture/desktop/windows-recovery-environment--windows-re--technical-reference?view=windows-11) “is a recovery environment that can repair common causes of unbootable operating systems." WinRE is preloaded in both Windows 10 and Windows 11. Once updated, the WinRE version on your Windows 11 PC should be 10.0.26100.7297.

[ForbesGoogle’s Android Warning—Hackers Gain Access To User AccountsBy Zak Doffman](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zakdoffman/2025/12/06/google-confirms-android-update-as-hackers-gain-access-to-accounts/)

As a reminder, your PC should now offer you a one-click toggle to install Windows 11 25H2, irregardless of whether you’re now running Windows 11 or Windows 10 — as long as your PC ticks the right boxes for Windows 11/s hardware hurdles.

Microsoft has also confirmed that these updates decisions now use a ‘machine-learning’ based approach. Per [*Windows Latest*](https://www.windowslatest.com/2025/12/06/microsoft-confirms-itll-auto-download-windows-11-25h2-using-machine-learning-based-approach-on-some-pcs/), “Microsoft is not talking about just ‘offering’ it like a normal download and install feature update. Instead, Windows Update will silently download version 25H2 in the background and let you decide if you want to install the update or postpone it.” And that decision is based on machine learning.

# World Boxing apologizes after naming Imane Khelif in mandatory sex testing announcement

Story by Reuters

World Boxing has apologized after Imane Khelif was named in their announcement on [mandatory sex testing](https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/30/sport/imane-khelif-world-boxing-sex-screening-spt?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_yahoo) for all boxers in their competitions, saying the Paris Olympics gold medalist’s privacy should have been protected.

The global body, which will oversee boxing competitions in the [2028 Olympics](https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/19/sport/imane-khelif-la-olympics-donald-trump-spt/index.html?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_yahoo) after being granted provisional recognition by the International Olympic Committee, made the announcement last week, less than a year after Khelif won [gold](https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/09/sport/imane-khelif-gold-medal-boxing-spt/index.html?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_yahoo) in Paris amid a gender-eligibility row.

The announcement specifically said the body had sent a letter to the Algerian Boxing Federation saying Khelif “may not participate in the female category” of any World Boxing event until she undergoes the test.

However, a source said World Boxing president Boris van der Vorst had personally written to Algerian Boxing Federation president Abdelkader Abbas to apologize for including Khelif’s name.

Van der Vorst said World Boxing should have made a greater effort to protect Khelif’s privacy.

In last week’s announcement, World Boxing said all athletes over the age of 18 will have to undertake a PCR (polymerase chain reaction) genetic test, which can be conducted by a nasal or mouth swab, saliva or blood.

Khelif and the Algerian Boxing Federation could not be immediately reached for comment.

The country’s federation joined World Boxing in September, one of more than 100 national federations that have joined the body since it was established in 2023.

# 百度（Baidu）近期新闻综合报告

## 1. 总体概述
近期市场对百度围绕人工智能芯片业务的结构调整和融资进展反应积极。多条报道显示，百度正在评估将旗下AI芯片子公司“昆仑芯”分拆并单独在香港上市的可能性（若推进将需履行相关监管审批）。相关消息推动百度港股和美股短期出现显著上涨，反映出市场对“AI+芯片”独立化、估值释放的强烈期待。

关键数字/信号：
- 昆仑芯近期完成融资，市场传出估值约210亿元人民币（报道口径）。
- 消息推动百度港股出现多次显著涨幅（报道显示有+5.2%、+7.8%等单日上涨），年内港股累计上涨约47.2%，美股年内上涨约40.8%。

## 2. 重点事件（2-3项）
1. 昆仑芯可能在港独立上市（子公司分拆/IPO评估）
   - 百度已公开称正在评估将AI芯片子公司昆仑芯分拆并单独在香港上市的方案。
   - 若推进需经过相关监管审批；昆仑芯近期融资后传出约210亿元人民币估值。
   - 该动作符合国内AI芯片企业上市潮（例如摩尔线程在上交所上市）的背景。

2. 市场对分拆上市预期的即时反应：股价显著上涨
   - 相关传闻/评估消息发布后，百度香港股价出现连续上涨并创数周新高，美股亦录得较大涨幅。短期内投资者对通过分拆释放子公司价值的预期较为明显。

## 3. 趋势分析
- 结构化与价值释放：百度探索将AI芯片业务单独上市，反映出中国大型科技公司通过分拆、独立融资来实现估值重估、吸引专项资本的趋势。这种做法既能在资本市场为硬件/芯片业务获得专门定价，也有助于外部引入战略投资者与融资渠道。
- 资本市场对AI与芯片板块的溢价延续：从市场反应看，投资者对AI核心资产（尤其是国产AI芯片）给予较高预期，促成相关公司股价短期快速上行。国内资本市场对芯片自主可控的关注度和支持也推动了这一潮流。
- 行业与监管风险并存：尽管市场情绪积极，但分拆与IPO需经过监管审批，且半导体行业具有高资本开支与技术迭代快的属性，竞争（国内外）、供应链与政策环境都会影响长期表现。再者，中国企业在海外上市/分拆时还需考虑跨境监管与信息披露要求。
- 战略层面的广域竞争：全球主要科技巨头（如微软、亚马逊、谷歌等）在AI与基础设施上持续加码（相关报道亦显示在印度与云服务/AI上的大量投入），百度推动自研芯片并拟独立上市，是在全球AI竞争背景下增强硬件与生态控制力的体现。

## 4. 风险与不确定性（简要）
- 审批与政策不确定性：分拆与上市须经多项监管审批，时间与结果存在不确定性。
- 估值兑现风险：市场对未来增长的预期可能过高，若芯片业务盈利化进展低于预期，子公司和母公司估值可能回调。
- 行业竞争与技术风险：芯片研发
